ELAP — Appeal — Elbert County — Beeutiful Things Inc.

key_facts.matter: Beeutiful Things Inc. is appealing the Elbert County COC's decision to disapprove their 2025 ELAP honeybee application for payment.
core_issues: CCC-771 initial colony report for CY 2025 filed Jan 16, 2026 — 14 days past the late-filed window (subsequent year's ARD of Jan 2, 2026)

Multiple internal inconsistencies between CCC-771, CCC-939H application (537 initial, 287 additions, 776 losses), CCC-870 (279 CCD losses in almond pollination), and receipts (816 colony purchase Dec 18, 2025)
CCC-771 shows only 48 colonies in inventory Nov 25, 2025 but application claims 537 initial + 287 additions
key_facts.appellant_position: Jan 2 ARD does not align with migratory beekeeping timelines — bees ship to California Nov/Dec for almond pollination, inventory not taken until mid-January. POA Christine DeMoss thought Dec 30 shipping receipt for 2026 beginning inventory would count as 2025 ending inventory.

agenda_items.title: CRP — Producer Self-Certification Recommendation
agenda_items.presenter: Hunter A. Cleveland, Agricultural Program Specialist

key_facts.matter: Review 2-CRP (Rev. 6) amendment 10 paragraph 508C — recommend to Colorado STAC which mid-contract management activities can be self-certified by CRP participants
key_facts.policy: 2-CRP (Rev. 6) paragraph 428A requires participants perform at least 1 management activity during contract life (by year 6 for 10-yr, year 9 for 15-yr).
key_facts.stac_subcommittee_vote: 4-1 to allow self-certification on ALL mid-contract management practices
key_facts.dissenting_view: Do not allow self-certification on haying — this practice just being brought back into the toolbox; historical experience shows producers hay too short (below 6" stubble) when not checked. Alternative: random field inspections by NRCS or partner staff.
key_facts.recommendation: STC to determine which management activities can be self-certified
